健康係您重視嘅財富，滙豐卓越理財作為首選健康支援及理財財富管理銀行夥伴*，我哋聯乘咗本地三大知名醫療機構包括香港中文大學醫院、港怡醫療及養和醫療集團旗下指定醫療中心🏥，提供專屬時段優先預約服務及低至8折門診禮遇🧑‍⚕，助您實現更全面嘅健康管理💪🏻。 滙豐卓越理財更提供一站式專屬醫療支援，包括第二醫療意見遙距諮詢及註冊護士上門護理😉！ 詳情請瀏覽：https://grp.hsbc/26HPBBCBCFT2 🎁由即日起至2026年8月31日，晉身滙豐卓越理財並完成指定交易，即可獲取價值超過港幣55,000元迎新獎賞！ *資料是根據《滙豐卓越理財富裕家庭健康報告》於2026年1-5月Ipsos進行的網上調查而得出。此調查共訪問了1,000名25歲以上，擁有個人流動資產總值達港幣100萬元或以上的香港居民，詳情可向Ipsos查詢。 受條款及細則約束。 本資訊及優惠旨在提供予香港境內人士。 Health and wellbeing are among your valuable assets. HSBC Premier, as the most preferred bank partner providing healthcare and wealth management services*, has partnered with three leading healthcare institutions in Hong Kong, including CUHK Medical Centre, Gleneagles Hong Kong, and HKSH Medical Group🏥, to offer exclusive priority booking slots and out-patient discounts of up to 20% at designated medical centres🧑‍⚕️, helping you access care with greater convenience💪🏻. HSBC Premier also provides one-stop healthcare support, including remote consultations for a second medical opinion and home nursing care by registered nurses😉! Learn more: https://grp.hsbc/26HPBBCBCFE2 🎁Join HSBC Premier on or before 31 August 2026 and complete designated transactions to unlock welcome rewards worth over HKD55,000! *Findings are based on the results of the ‘HSBC Premier Affluent Family Health Report’, conducted online in January - May 2026 by Ipsos. The survey engaged 1,000 aged 25 or above residents in Hong Kong, with HK$1 million or above in liquid assets. For more details, please contact Ipsos. Terms and conditions apply. The information and offer are intended for persons in HK only. #滙豐 #滙豐卓越理財 #市場首創 #健康支援 #HSBC #HSBCPremier #MarketFirst #HealthSupport
